Show a chart of India's GDP growth for the last 5 years
11:56 PM

India's real GDP growth over the last five financial years went from a Covid dip of about -5.8% in 2020-21 to a rebound of about 9.7% in 2021-22, then eased to about 6.5% in 2024-25. These are approximate figures from my memory, not checked live, and official numbers get revised. Check the latest release from the Ministry of Statistics before you quote them.
